info.name: Silos API
info.description:
Collection for the Silos object storage platform.

Authentication:
- Dashboard endpoints (/api/auth, /api/projects, /api/folders, /api/api-keys) use a JWT session cookie named `silos_session`.
  Run `Auth / Login` first — Postman stores the cookie automatically for subsequent requests.
- Public API endpoints (/api/v1/*) use API Key authentication: `Authorization: Bearer <api-key>`.
  Set the `apiKey` collection variable after creating a key.

Variables:
- baseUrl: base URL of the app (default http://localhost:3000)
- apiKey: API key used by /api/v1/* requests
- projectId / folderId / fileId / apiKeyId: auto-filled by the test scripts of create requests

request.description: Login to the dashboard. Sets the `silos_session` cookie used by all dashboard endpoints.
Change the password of the logged in user. New password must be at least 8 characters.
Get all projects accessible by the logged in user, including api_keys and files counts.
Create a new project. `name` must be unique. Saves the new id into the `projectId` variable.
Update a project name. Fails if another project already uses the name.
Read the upload limits of a project. Null values mean "no limit".
Update the upload limits of a project. Send null to remove a limit, and an empty allowed_mime list to accept every supported type.
Soft delete a project together with its API keys and files (status set to 0).

query.description: Optional parent folder id. Leave empty for root level.

request.description: Get folders and files inside a project, optionally scoped to a parent folder.
Create a folder inside a project. `parent_id` is optional (null for root). Saves the new id into the `folderId` variable.
Rename a folder by folder id.
Soft delete a folder by folder id.

query.description: Optional key name or project name filter

request.description: Get API key metadata accessible by the logged in user: name, key_prefix, last4, scopes, last_used_at, expires_at and status. The plaintext key and its hash are never returned.

Create an API key for a project. The response contains the plaintext key exactly once (format `silos_` + 64 hex chars); only its SHA-256 hash and display metadata are stored. The test script saves the key into `apiKey`.
Get active API keys of a project as metadata only (name, key_prefix, last4, scopes, last_used_at, expires_at, status).
Rename an API key.
Revoke an API key immediately (status 0 + revoked_at).
Create a replacement key. The previous key keeps working for 24 hours (expires_at is moved), then authentication rejects it. The new plaintext key is returned once and saved into `apiKey`.
Dashboard upload authenticated by the session cookie, no API key. Max 4 MB; the declared MIME type must match the content. The browser never receives an API key.
Dashboard delete (session cookie). Deletes the R2 object first, then the row; a missing object counts as success. Only active files of projects the session may access.

exec: // Public API requires an API key. Cookie sessions are ignored here.

request.description: Upload a file. Multipart form-data with `file` (required) and optional `folder_id` (must belong to the same project). Max 4 MB. The declared content type must be allowed and match the file's magic bytes (images, PDF, audio/video, text/plain, text/csv, zip, Office documents); HTML, SVG and JavaScript are rejected with 415. Saves the new id into the `fileId` variable.

query.description: Empty or omitted means "use the key's project". A different project is rejected with 400.
Optional folder filter. Omit to list root files.

request.description: List files of the project owning the API key, with their public URLs. An empty project_id is ignored; a project_id naming another project is rejected with 400. object_key in the response is deprecated and only present for legacy keys of public files.
Get a single file by its File ID, including its public URL.
Delete a file by File ID. Removes the storage object, purges its public URL from the CDN cache and deletes the database record.

Storage of the project that owns the API key (requires the usage:read scope). files/bytes count active files; pending_files/pending_bytes count uploads in flight. The tenant always comes from the key.

item.name: Direct Uploads (beta)
item.description:
Beta: requires UPLOADS_V2_ENABLED=true on the server (every route answers 404 otherwise).

Flow: Initiate Upload -> PUT the bytes to the returned URL with exactly the returned headers -> Complete Upload. Files above the single-PUT threshold are multipart: the response lists part URLs, and `Resend Multipart Part URLs` issues fresh ones for the same upload_id (parts already uploaded keep their ETag).

Idempotency: send a `client_ref` (unique per project while the row exists). A retry with the same client_ref and the same filename/size returns the same file_id; a different filename/size returns 409 CLIENT_REF_CONFLICT.

Error codes: FILE_TOO_LARGE (size above 2147483647 bytes), MIME_NOT_ALLOWED (type outside the allow-list, or stored type does not match), FREE_TIER_GUARD (global storage limit reached), CLIENT_REF_CONFLICT, UPLOAD_CANCELLED (aborted while a retry arrived), VALIDATION_ERROR.

request.description: Creates a PENDING upload and returns `file_id`, `mode` (single|multipart) and either `upload` (presigned PUT URL, method, headers, expires_at) or `multipart` (upload_id, part_size, part_count, parts).

header.description: Must equal the mime_type sent to Initiate Upload; it is part of the signature.

request.description: PUT the raw bytes straight to storage. Copy every header returned by Initiate Upload (content-type, cache-control, content-disposition, x-amz-meta-*); do not add content-length. The URL expires after 15 minutes and the bytes never pass through the Silos server.

Verifies the stored object (HEAD + first bytes) and flips the row to ACTIVE. For a multipart upload send `{"parts":[{"n":1,"etag":"\"...\""}]}` with every part ETag. An oversize or mismatched object is deleted and the call fails; a row that is no longer PENDING returns 404.
Fresh part URLs (15 minutes) for the same multipart upload_id. Use it when a part URL expired instead of starting a new upload; parts uploaded with the previous URLs stay valid.
Cancels a pending upload: aborts the multipart upload, deletes any stored object and removes the row. Free operation. Completing afterwards returns 404.

Up to UPLOAD_MAX_FILES_PER_BATCH (default 50) files in one request. Partial success is normal: the response is 200 with one result per item (`ok: true` with data, or `ok: false` with code and message). The global storage guard is evaluated on the sum of the whole batch.
